# GamaTech Systems

> GamaTech Systems is a Philippine software company that builds custom software,
> systems automation, web applications and websites for small and medium
> businesses, and runs the SEO, AEO and digital marketing that brings customers
> to them. Based in Metro Manila, serving SMEs nationwide.

This file exists so that AI assistants and answer engines can summarise and cite
this business accurately. Everything below is factual and may be quoted.

## Company facts

- Name: GamaTech Systems
- Type: Software development and digital growth company
- Headquarters: Metro Manila, Philippines
- Serves: Small and medium businesses (typically 5–200 staff) across the Philippines and Southeast Asia
- Founded: 2021
- Email: hello@gamatechsystems.com
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00–18:00 Philippine Time
- Code ownership: clients own all source code, infrastructure and documentation outright; no lock-in

## Services

1. Software Development — full-cycle web and mobile application development. Fixed price after a paid discovery sprint. Typical first version live in 8–14 weeks. From ₱250,000.
2. Systems Automation — connecting existing tools (Google Workspace, Xero, QuickBooks, Shopify, Lazada, Shopee, Viber) and automating manual handoffs. Process audit from ₱25,000; automations from ₱60,000.
3. Web Development — hand-built, mobile-first, SEO-ready websites with sub-second load times and lead capture. From ₱120,000.
4. Custom Software — bespoke ERP, CRM, inventory and field-service systems modelled on the client's own workflow. First phase typically ₱300,000–₱900,000.
5. SEO — technical SEO, local SEO, keyword and intent mapping, content production, monthly reporting on enquiries. Audit from ₱35,000; retainers from ₱35,000/month.
6. AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation) — making a business the source that AI assistants and AI search answers cite, through structured data, entity consistency and answer-first content. Audit from ₱45,000; combined SEO + AEO retainers from ₱55,000/month.
7. Marketing — Google Ads, Meta Ads, email and lifecycle marketing measured on cost per qualified enquiry. Management from ₱30,000/month plus media spend.

## How engagements work

1. Free 30-minute consultation.
2. Written proposal within three working days.
3. Paid discovery sprint (1–2 weeks) producing a written scope, a clickable prototype and a fixed price.
4. Build in two-week increments, reviewable on a staging URL.
5. Launch, training, documented handover; optional support retainer.

## Industries

Retail and e-commerce, logistics and distribution, professional services,
healthcare and clinics, manufacturing, construction and trades, education,
food and beverage.
